title: stainless steel double walled glasses with plastic lids
text:
stainless steel double walled glasses with plastic lids. UPDATE below.....You get four, stainless containers with clear plastic lids with slots for drinking (no slides to prevent spills). They also came with 4 straws and 2 straw cleaner brushes. Says they are dishwasher safe, I've put them in. They seem kind of lightweight - so I hope they actually are stainless and doubled walled. Also says it keeps cold drinks cold for 24 hours - I will update my review should new info seem useful.
UPDATE: 8/12/2020.... Just a note. If you FILL the cup with ice to the top, add water and use in room temp (70 degrees) - the ice is visible for about 6-7 hours. It's not exactly 24 hours. But it's ok. Just want to provide the actual use info and report that what is posted is not exactly accurate. I also noted that they are fairly light and not as thick as other double walled cups I have purchased. There is also some sweating that occurs at the very top, outside of the cup. It doesn't drip down the cup - but it is there. Hope this info is helpful.
